FN-RT26MYM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 118
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 118 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Private Investigation
Board until October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise
affect state or local funding.
Page 1
